1.mascotDialogue: One edge, two entries in the adjacency matrix. Forget the second, and you've quietly built half a directed graph instead.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 2 and line 3 aren't optional extras of one another — they're the same conceptual edge, and must be added as a single atomic pair, every time.

3.mascotDialogue: No arrowheads this time, just a plain line, because the connection is inherently mutual.

4.mascotDialogue: The visual shows a single arrowhead where an undirected graph should never have one at all — that mismatch is the bug, made rather hard to miss.
